name: campaign_merge_state
description: Idempotently merge completed campaign tasks, resumable sessions, remaining tasks, and completed waves.

added.description: Task IDs newly completed this wave, appended to 'completed'. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

completed.description: Task IDs already completed in prior waves. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

newSessions.description: New task-ID-to-session-ID entries from this wave, merged into 'sessions'. Accepts an object map, or an array of session IDs positionally zipped with 'added'.

sessions.description: Existing map of task ID to session ID, accepts an object map or a JSON-encoded string of one.

remaining.description: Task IDs not yet completed, filtered to drop any that are now in 'completed'. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

waves.description: Wave numbers already recorded as processed. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array.

wave.description: Current wave number to append to 'waves', if not null.

completed.description: De-duplicated union of previously completed and newly added task IDs, in first-seen order.

sessions.description: Merged map of task ID to resumable session ID.

remaining.description: Task IDs from 'remaining' input that are not in 'completed'.

waves.description: De-duplicated list of wave numbers processed, with the current wave appended if not null.
